components.name: Warm chocolate brownie
components.note: The smaller brownie provides the dense, fudgy centre of the dessert, with a rich chocolate flavour and warm, gooey texture.

components.name: Belgian chocolate sauce
components.note: The rich Belgian chocolate sauce tops the brownie and adds another layer of chocolate flavour to the smaller dessert.

components.name: Vanilla ice cream
components.note: A scoop of soft vanilla ice cream brings a cold contrast to the warm brownie, melting as you eat.

taste:
This is a dense, fudgy chocolate dessert rather than a light finish, despite its smaller size. The brownie arrives warm, with a gooey texture and an intensely rich chocolate flavour. Belgian chocolate sauce adds more richness on top, so the appeal is concentrated chocolate rather than a large portion. Choose it when you want less pudding, not less intensity.

The soft vanilla ice cream gives each spoonful a contrast between warm brownie and cold ice cream. As the scoop melts, you can eat the brownie, sauce and ice cream together. That temperature contrast is a central part of the dessert, especially while the brownie is still warm.
